Game clients that updated to 1.3.5.1 refuse a 1.3.4.2 server, so this is the build current clients join. The connector names game classes and functions by reflection, not code addresses, so the target needs no source change. The connector is the UE4SS mod TakaroSCUM: Lua scripts that find the game's classes by reflection, plus main.dll, a UE4SS C++ mod that holds the Takaro WebSocket (WinHTTP). UE4SS runs with only the EngineTick and ProcessEvent hooks; its stock hook set crashes this server build on player join. The live tests ran an MSVC v143 build of main.dll; the release build cross-compiles the same sources with clang-cl against the pinned MSVC CRT and Windows SDK, and checks every UE4SS import against the pinned UE4SS.dll.

notes: The Windows server is not run in a container anywhere in this repository: the runtime image is recorded only because the schema requires one, and runtime verification is off for this connector. main.dll is cross-compiled on Linux (clang-cl and lld-link 1:19.1.7-3+b1 from the pinned Debian 13.7 image, installed at that exact version by the build script; MSVC CRT 14.44.17.14 and Windows SDK 10.0.26100 fetched by the pinned xwin and checked against a tree digest). UE4SS is bundled because its experimental-latest release moves; the zip is pinned by sha256. Depot 1004 is Valve's redistributable depot, pinned because the proven install carried it.
